'''2008 Worlds Team Danny Chu DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Danny Chu]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Informal notebook. Team Albany goes to MN. Header also Mild Hammonree - Dark.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Danny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
